about: One entry per shetach. territory lists what it covers: a US state or Canadian province (US-TX, CA-ON), a Mexican or Australian state (MX-JAL, AU-NSW), or a whole country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3: FRA, DEU; ISR is all of Israel, including Judea and Samaria (the West Bank) and the Golan Heights); the part of a US state east and/or west of a longitude ({ "state": "US-PA", "westOf": -78.13 }); counties by 5-digit FIPS ({ "counties": [...] }); towns ({ "state": "US-MA", "towns": [...] }); census tracts ({ "state": "US-MA", "tracts": [...] }); regions of a country by their GADM name ({ "country": "GRC", "level": 2, "regions": ["Central Macedonia"] }; level 1 unless given; claims at several levels can be combined, the finer winning), or regional units of a country GADM has no level for ({ "country": "GRC", "regionalUnits": ["Thessaloniki"] }, as their municipalities, REGIONAL_UNITS in the build); or a boundary shape from data/shapes/ inside a state ({ "state": "AU-QLD", "shape": "brisbane-metro" }).

Where claims overlap, the more specific one wins: tracts, then towns and shapes, then counties and regions, then longitude lines, then whole states and countries. Anything no shetach claims is left blank.

short: the label used where the name doesn't fit, or a list of them from longest to shortest, used as the shetach gets smaller on screen (["Carolinas", "Car."]); a single whole state defaults to its own abbreviation (TX), and state codes are never joined unless given (KS-MO). capital: the chabad.org center id of the shetach's headquarters (the number in its chabad.org link), or lat and lon; "world": true marks 770. headTitle: what the card calls the head ("Head shliach" unless given, e.g. "Leadership"). lastName is optional; it defaults to the last word of headShliach. notShown: areas left off the map entirely. notShownWhenBlank: states left off the map wherever no shetach claims them (the Northwest Territories and Yukon north of 63°N). labelState: the state whose part of the shetach carries its name on the map (Alberta, for the territories north of it). labelAt: [lon, lat] the name centres on in the SVG maps. territoryOf: a territory of another shetach, under the same head (India, of Thailand's): shown in that shetach's colour, lighter, with a dashed border between, and named "India (Thailand)".
